module: "Get Vehicle Wheel Center" node (category `repeat_instant`, tags telemetry/wheel). Computes the average of the wheel positions (first axis node of each wheel) plus the vehicle position. Input pin: `vehId` (default 0, otherwise player). Output: `wheelCenter` (vec3).
notes: If the vehicle has only one wheel (`getWheelCount() - 1` equals 0), the center stays at the vehicle position.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Computes the wheel center and writes it to `wheelCenter`.
